title: Seed to Snack ABC
hook: Down in soil, up to sun—A-B-C!
Round and round, the garden cycle runs.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D vegetable-garden storybook, fresh produce colors, soft rounded forms, clean single-object compositions

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child tracing how soil, tiny life, seed, water and plants connect in a repeating garden cycle
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: remind the listener that the story loops from below the soil up to light and back again
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: walking 4/4 circular folk groove with returning melodic tail
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written cycle language; use down/up/back/again selectively, distinguish edible crops from flowers/tools/helpers, and connect each fact to soil, water, seed, root, leaf or return when truthful
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: cycle cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe grow/trace/pour/pick/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Reveal the garden as a cycle rather than a straight list: old plant matter feeds soil, hidden life moves through it, seeds and roots become leaves, flowers and food, and the cycle can begin again.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A curious child keeps asking where garden food and growth come from; circular language—down, up, back, again—connects soil life, seed, root, flower and harvest.
imageMotifs: food and flowers returning to the bed
semanticArc: begin with what protects and feeds the soil
follow hidden life and climbing growth
reach roots, pods, fruit and seed
return water and plant matter so another cycle can begin
